description: Cursor workflow to build www.anirudhlabs.in (Next.js frontend + Strapi CMS) and deploy both services to Google Cloud Run. Step-by-step tasks from repo creation through CI/CD and domain mapping. Supports multiple Cursor agents and includes a Cursor Rules file for agent coordination.

cards.title: Create GitHub repository and branch policy
cards.description: Create a new GitHub repo `anirudhlabs-site` with `dev` and protected `main`. Add README, license and basic issue templates.
checklist: Create repo `anirudhlabs-site`
Add README.md with project summary
Add LICENSE (MIT) and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
Create `dev` branch and protect `main` requiring PR reviews and passing CI
Add CODEOWNERS file to require review
cards.acceptance_criteria: Repo exists with `dev` as working branch, protection on `main`, and initial README.

cards.title: Create GCP project & enable APIs
cards.description: Create a Google Cloud Project (id: anirudhlabs-prod-<random>) and enable required APIs: Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL Admin, Secret Manager, Cloud DNS, Cloud Storage, IAM.
checklist: Create GCP project with billing enabled
Enable APIs: Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL Admin, Secret Manager, Cloud DNS, Cloud Storage, IAM
Create service account `ci-deployer@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with roles: Cloud Run Admin, Storage Admin, Cloud Build Editor, Artifact Registry Writer, Cloud SQL Client
Store service account key in Secret Manager and GitHub secret
cards.acceptance_criteria: GCP project exists, APIs enabled and service account created.

cards.title: Verify domain & DNS access (anirudhlabs.in)
cards.description: Confirm ownership of `anirudhlabs.in` and ensure access to DNS provider console (Cloudflare/Namecheap/GoDaddy). Document registrar details.
checklist: Confirm domain ownership of `anirudhlabs.in`
Confirm DNS provider and login credentials stored securely
Add a note with domain registrar details in project docs
cards.acceptance_criteria: Domain ownership confirmed and DNS console access verified.

cards.title: Scaffold Next.js frontend
cards.description: Create a Next.js project in `/frontend` with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MDX support, glass-gradient theme tokens, basic pages: /, /about, /projects, /articles, /sops. Include `next.config.js` with security headers and `server.js` for Cloud Run.
checklist: npx create-next-app --ts in /frontend
Install Tailwind & configure theme tokens (glass gradient variables)
Add MDX support for articles and SOP content
Create base components: Header, Footer, Hero, Card, Timeline
Add sample About page that links to downloadable resume (pdf)
Add next.config.js headers for HSTS, CSP and others
cards.acceptance_criteria: Frontend builds locally (npm run dev) and shows homepage + About.

cards.title: Scaffold Strapi CMS
cards.description: Initialize Strapi project in `/cms`. Create content-types: Project, Article, SOP, Resume (singleType). Configure upload plugin to use local provider initially; add CORS for frontend origin.
checklist: npx create-strapi-app cms --quickstart (or manual setup) in /cms
Create content-types and fields: Project (title, slug, summary, body, tags, images, metrics), Article (title, slug, body, tags), SOP (title, version, steps), Resume (file, summary)
Create admin user and verify admin UI at http://localhost:1337/admin
Configure CORS to allow frontend origin (http://localhost:3000)
cards.acceptance_criteria: Strapi admin accessible locally and content types created.

cards.title: Add Dockerfiles and docker-compose
cards.description: Add production-ready Dockerfiles for frontend and cms, and a docker-compose for local development connecting Strapi (Postgres) and Frontend.
checklist: Add `/frontend/Dockerfile` with build + runtime stages
Add `/cms/Dockerfile` for Strapi
Add `docker-compose.yml` to run frontend, cms, and postgres locally
Test docker-compose up and verify both services run
cards.acceptance_criteria: Both services run via docker-compose and accessible.

cards.title: Create sample Projects & Articles
cards.description: Populate CMS (or MDX) with 3 projects and 2 articles derived from resume. Each project must have measurable results and tech stack tags.
checklist: Write project 1: ETL validation pipeline (problem, approach, results)
Write project 2: Airflow orchestration + monitoring
Write project 3: QA automation & CI/CD integration
Publish 2 articles: Introduction to ETL validation and Designing QA automation frameworks
Verify projects appear in frontend via API
cards.acceptance_criteria: 3 projects and 2 articles visible on /projects and /articles pages without code deploy (runtime fetch).

cards.title: Set up GitHub Actions CI to build and test
cards.description: Add CI workflow to run lint, typecheck, build frontend and run Strapi smoke test on PRs to dev branch.
checklist: Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to run npm install, lint, build for frontend
Add smoke-start test for Strapi service
Require CI passing to merge to main
cards.acceptance_criteria: CI pipeline runs on PR and passes build step.

cards.title: Provision Cloud SQL (Postgres) and GCS bucket
cards.description: Create a Postgres instance for Strapi and a GCS bucket for media uploads. Create a service account with appropriate roles and store key in Secret Manager.
checklist: Create Cloud SQL Postgres instance with instance connection name
Create DB user and database `strapi`
Create GCS bucket `anirudhlabs-media`
Create service account `strapi-gcs-sa@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and grant Storage Admin role
Add service account key to Secret Manager and grant Cloud Run service account access
cards.acceptance_criteria: Cloud SQL reachable from Cloud Run via connector and GCS bucket accessible by Strapi service account.

cards.title: Configure Strapi for Cloud SQL & GCS in env
cards.description: Update Strapi `database.js` to use Cloud SQL connection string and configure upload provider to GCS using service account credentials from Secret Manager.
checklist: Set DATABASE_URL to use Cloud SQL connection (cloudsql instance connection name)
Set GCS credentials from Secret Manager in Strapi env
Test Strapi can connect to DB and upload media to GCS locally (using service account)
cards.acceptance_criteria: Strapi connects to cloud sql and can store/retrieve media from GCS.

sprints.name: Sprint 4 - Build & Deploy to Cloud Run (staging)

cards.title: Build & push container images using Cloud Build
cards.description: Use Cloud Build to build and push frontend and cms images to Artifact Registry.
checklist: Create Artifact Registry repositories for frontend and cms
Add cloudbuild YAML to build images and tag with commit sha
Trigger Cloud Build on push to `dev` branch
Verify images are created in Artifact Registry
cards.acceptance_criteria: Images available in Artifact Registry after Cloud Build.

cards.title: Deploy Strapi to Cloud Run (staging) with Cloud SQL
cards.description: Deploy the Strapi image to Cloud Run and connect Cloud SQL using the `--add-cloudsql-instances` flag. Set environment variables via Secret Manager.
checklist: gcloud run deploy anirudhlabs-cms --image <artifact-registry-url> --add-cloudsql-instances=<INSTANCE_CONNECTION_NAME> --region=us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated
Set env vars: DATABASE_URL (cloudsql), STRAPI_ADMIN_JWT_SECRET, JWT_SECRET
Confirm admin UI reachable at https://cms-<...>.run.app/admin
Upload sample media and verify persistence in GCS
cards.acceptance_criteria: Strapi admin accessible on Cloud Run and connected to Cloud SQL and GCS.

cards.title: Deploy Frontend to Cloud Run (staging)
cards.description: Deploy Next.js frontend to Cloud Run using production build; configure `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` to point to the Strapi Cloud Run service URL. Use server.js to bind to $PORT.
checklist: gcloud run deploy anirudhlabs-frontend --image <artifact-registry-url> --region=us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://cms-<...>.run.app
Visit frontend staging URL and verify it fetches content from Strapi
Enable Cloud Run automatic HTTPS
cards.acceptance_criteria: Frontend accessible and renders projects/articles from the deployed Strapi instance.

cards.title: Map custom domain to frontend Cloud Run service
cards.description: Add domain mapping in Cloud Run console for `www.anirudhlabs.in`. Verify domain ownership via TXT record and create DNS records as instructed.
checklist: In Cloud Run -> Domain mappings -> Add mapping for `www.anirudhlabs.in`
Add TXT record to DNS provider to verify ownership
Add A or CNAME records as provided by Cloud Run
Wait for SSL cert provisioning and confirm HTTPS works
cards.acceptance_criteria: https://www.anirudhlabs.in serves the frontend over HTTPS.

cards.title: Secure Strapi admin access
cards.description: Protect Strapi admin UI either via Cloud IAP or by limiting access to known admin IPs and enabling strong passwords + 2FA for admin users.
checklist: Decide on protection method (IAP or IP whitelist)
If using IAP, enable IAP and configure OAuth client
Enforce strong password policy and enable 2FA for admin accounts
cards.acceptance_criteria: Strapi admin is not publicly writable and requires auth via chosen protection method.

sprints.name: Sprint 6 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions to Cloud Build/Cloud Run

cards.title: GitHub Actions -> trigger Cloud Build
cards.description: Add GitHub Actions workflow that triggers Cloud Build on push to `main`. Cloud Build will build images and deploy Cloud Run services automatically.
checklist: Create GCP service account key and store in GitHub Secrets
Add GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` that calls gcloud or triggers Cloud Build API
Test by merging dev -> main and verify deployment
cards.acceptance_criteria: Merging to `main` triggers CI which builds images and deploys to Cloud Run.

cards.title: Add healthchecks and logging
cards.description: Add readiness routes, integrate Sentry for errors, and ensure logs flow to Cloud Logging. Create basic uptime check (Cloud Monitoring).
checklist: Add /health endpoint for frontend and cms
Integrate Sentry DSN in both services for error capture
Configure Cloud Monitoring uptime check
cards.acceptance_criteria: Sentry receives test events and Cloud Monitoring shows service as healthy.

cards.title: Deploy n8n to Cloud Run
cards.description: Containerize n8n and deploy to Cloud Run. Secure with auth. Configure webhook endpoint for Strapi publish events.
checklist: Create n8n image and push to Artifact Registry
Deploy to Cloud Run with env variables for encryption keys
Set basic auth or token for webhook security
cards.acceptance_criteria: n8n runs and accepts authenticated webhook requests from Strapi.

cards.title: Workflow: CMS publish -> Telegram + LinkedIn draft
cards.description: Create an n8n workflow: on publish webhook -> generate short snippet (templated) -> post to Telegram channel; create draft/preview for LinkedIn (store result in Airtable or as draft in GitHub PR).
checklist: Webhook in Strapi to call n8n on publish
n8n node to format snippet using CMS fields
n8n Telegram node to send message to channel
n8n action to create LinkedIn draft (or store in repo)
cards.acceptance_criteria: Publishing content triggers Telegram message and a LinkedIn draft is generated.

cards.title: Security review & pen-test checklist
cards.description: Run through a small security checklist: secret rotation, IAM least privilege, remove public DB access, enable HTTPS, check CORS policies.
checklist: Rotate keys in Secret Manager
Ensure Cloud SQL does not allow public access
Lock down IAM roles and service accounts
Confirm HTTPS on frontend domain
cards.acceptance_criteria: Pen-test checklist items verified and documented.

cards.title: Final launch tasks
cards.description: DNS final switch (if needed), monitor first 24 hours for errors, set SLOs and rollback plan.
checklist: If using a temporary domain for staging, switch DNS to production mapping
Run smoke tests for critical flows (home, projects, admin login) post-launch
Document rollback steps and validate backups
cards.acceptance_criteria: Site live at https://www.anirudhlabs.in, smoke tests pass and monitoring alerts set.

cursor_rules.description: Rules for coordinating multiple Cursor agents working on this project.

rules.title: Agent responsibilities & ownership
rules.description: Each agent must set 'assignee' on cards it claims. Agents may only work on cards assigned to them or explicitly claimed via a PR comment.

rules.title: PR & Code Review policy
rules.description: All code changes must be merged via PR into `dev`. Main protected requiring 1 reviewer and passing CI. Agents should add a short summary and link to related card in PR description.

rules.title: Environment & Secrets handling
rules.description: No agent should commit secrets to repo. Use GitHub secrets and GCP Secret Manager. Agents must reference secret keys via env var names only.

rules.title: Deployment approval
rules.description: Deploy to production (Cloud Run with domain mapping) requires explicit approval by 'owner' or 'Ops-Agent' in Cursor; CI must be green.

rules.title: Quality & Testing
rules.description: Every feature card must include acceptance criteria; at least one E2E smoke test must pass before marking done.

agent_roles.Frontend-Agent: Responsible for Next.js UI, components, styling and client integration.
agent_roles.CMS-Agent: Responsible for Strapi models, plugins, CORS, and content migration.
agent_roles.Infra-Agent: Responsible for Dockerfiles, CI, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, and Cloud Run deployments.
agent_roles.CI-Agent: Responsible for GitHub Actions, Cloud Build triggers and CI quality gates.
agent_roles.Automation-Agent: Responsible for n8n workflows and social automation (later phases).
agent_roles.Security-Agent: Responsible for IAP, secrets, role bindings, and security checks.
agent_roles.Content-Agent: Responsible for writing initial content (projects, articles, SOPs).
agent_roles.Ops-Agent: Responsible for DNS, domain mapping and DNS record updates.
